name: VAR2
tagline: Create images, videos, music, voice, and 3D assets
description: VAR2 provides creative generation tools for images, videos, music, voice, and 3D assets through a remote MCP server. A VAR2 account and OAuth authorization are required. Generation uses paid VAR2 credits.

install.notes: Authorize with your VAR2 account using OAuth after installation. Generation uses paid VAR2 credits. See https://www.var2.ai/mcp for setup guidance.
